status: approved Ember material (the blue/amber study): black leather panels, menu and input bar, navy leather for "You" and every Home card, copper fittings from the original Ember plate art, warm ivory ink and copper accents; no ivory input surface

choices.surfaces: card, chrome and page #131310 are the mean of the black leather grown from the study's own panels (the plate under the leather and its fallback): the menu, the header and every panel are that black; raised #23303D stays blue charcoal
choices.user: #142036 is the mean of the navy leather (the study's grain under its navy): "You" and every Home card; user anchors use the ivory user ink, and the leather's brightest pixel keeps the copper control border at 3:1
choices.inputs: #192A3B with #F1E8DA ivory ink owns inline editors and settings fields; no ivory surface or opaque parchment texture is applied to any input
choices.accents: existing warm copper #C58F71 controls/links and #D9AB8D focus balance the cool surfaces; #885440 frame and #66564A divider remain decorative
choices.scope: layout, behavior, other materials and all artwork are unchanged by these palette choices
choices.leather: the leathers are seamless tiles grown from the study's own creased grain (packages/frontend/scripts/skin-art/texgen.py) at 92% over their plate colour, highlights rolled off under every ink's bound; the copper brackets are cut from the original Ember plate art (packages/frontend/scripts/skin-art/corners.py)
choices.composer: #131310, the black leather, replaces the study's ivory input bar; the bar is the field (the message field inside it is clear) and its placeholder is the muted ink #B5A697
choices.geometry: cards and panels are nearly square (3px) with the copper fittings at their corners; the chat bubbles and the input bar are rounded (8px) with no fittings; chips 4px
